newsitem.title: GERMANY: Kuehne & Nagel expands E.Europe outlets.
newsitem.headline: Kuehne & Nagel expands E.Europe outlets.

text.p: International freight forwarder Kuehne & Nagel AG said it has expanded its eastern Europe facilities to 40 stations in 14 countries.

Chief executive officer Klaus-Michael Kuehne said in a speech to 200 employees of parent company Viag AG that 12 premises were added last year, including the purchase of terminals in Budapest and Riga.
Kuehne & Nagel has started construction work on a 7,000 square metres logistics terminal in Poznan, Poland, which will open in early 1997, a company statement said.
The forwarder said it plans to build a complex covering at first 1,000 square metres in Prague.
Other new projects include planned warehouses in Kazakhstan, Albania and Romania, the statement said. --Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 8982 Fax +44 171 542 5017
